subject: Recap: Dedicated capacity fit — NeuralWave (predictable TPS & isolation)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Anika Shah <anika@neuralwave.ai>, Raj Patel <raj@neuralwave.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Nov 2025 17:04:00 -0800
Subject: Recap: Dedicated capacity fit — NeuralWave (predictable TPS & isolation)

Thanks again for the call today — great to meet the NeuralWave team. Quick write-up to capture the key pain points, success criteria, and proposed next steps so we're all aligned. Please flag anything I missed.

Key pain points we heard
- Unpredictable tail latency and throughput due to multi-tenant noise on your current managed endpoints.
- Intermittent OOMs during peak annotation runs; need guaranteed isolation for sensitive customer workloads.
- Spike behavior: short bursts up to ~500 TPS for 5-20 minute windows; steady-state target ~100 TPS during business hours.
- Budget sensitivity for steady-state vs burst capacity — you prefer a cost-predictable reserved model with defined burst policy.

Current stack (call notes)
- Inference: HF-hosted endpoints with spot-backed GPU autoscaling on AWS.
- Models: Llama-variant, 16-bit quantized; serving through a custom batching layer.
- Observability: basic Prometheus metrics, limited token-level cost visibility.

Success criteria for Dedicated fit
- Sustained 100 TPS (8-hour window) with p95 generation latency < 120ms for typical prompts.
- Ability to absorb bursts to 500 TPS with graceful degradation and pre-defined fallback (cheaper model variant).
- Network/isolation: customer-dedicated GPU pool (no noisy neighbor risk) + VPC peering / private endpoint.
- Measurable unit economics: per-token unit cost under target (we'll surface estimates).

Proposed immediate next steps
1) NeuralWave to send: historical traffic sample (CSV) + sensitivity matrix (latency vs quality) — you mentioned being able to share a week of anonymized traces.
2) Redwood to produce: initial capacity match (GPU count/config) + pilot cost ballpark and pilot SOW draft.
3) Schedule a technical deep dive (Vivek suggested) to validate KV cache behavior, batching, and model variants.
4) Procurement touchpoint for pilot contracting — include procurement@neuralwave.ai.

Attachments referenced: [Attachment: NeuralWave_traffic_samples.csv (CSV, ~2MB)], [Attachment: NeuralWave_sensitivity_matrix.pdf (PDF, 560KB)].

Proposed pilot idea (rough): 6-week reserved pool (3-4 x A10035GB or equiv), can autoscale burst via short-term spot-backed warm nodes; baseline isolation + canary rollback to lower-cost model variant.

Proposed dates:
- Technical deep-dive: Nov 14–17 window (30–45m)
- Pilot kickoff (if agreed): week of Nov 24

Thanks — I looped Vivek and Sergio for the engineering and ops checks. Looking forward to the traffic sample.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0132
Redwood Inference

From: Anika Shah <anika@neuralwave.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Raj Patel <raj@neuralwave.ai>
Cc: NeuralWave Procurement <procurement@neuralwave.ai>
Date: Wed, 12 Nov 2025 19:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Recap: Dedicated capacity fit — NeuralWave (predictable TPS & isolation)

Marissa — thanks for the clear recap and the proposed pilot outline. Couple quick clarifications and we've attached the files you requested.

Clarifications:
- The 100 TPS steady-state is our business SLA target for the primary API (text-generation). We currently see bursts up to ~480 TPS for short windows — 500 is a safe planning number.
- For privacy-sensitive workloads we require isolated tenancy but can run non-sensitive workloads in a lower-cost shared pool.
- Our team uses Datadog and a homegrown batching layer; we can provide sample Prometheus-format metrics if helpful.

Attached: NeuralWave_traffic_samples.csv (anonymized), NeuralWave_sensitivity_matrix.pdf (latency vs quality per model).

Procurement is copied for pilot contracting; Raj will be primary on procurement/commercials. Quick ask — can you provide a rough monthly delta in cost for reserved pool vs on-demand for the pilot (order of magnitude) so procurement has a sense before SOW?

Happy to take the technical deep-dive on Nov 14 at 10am PT if that works for your team.

Thanks,
Anika Shah
Head of Platform Engineering, NeuralWave
anika@neuralwave.ai
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Anika Shah <anika@neuralwave.ai>, Raj Patel <raj@neuralwave.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, NeuralWave Procurement <procurement@neuralwave.ai>
Date: Thu, 13 Nov 2025 08:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Recap: Dedicated capacity fit — NeuralWave (predictable TPS & isolation)

Anika — appreciate the quick turnaround and the attachments. Got the CSV and matrix.

Quick answers:
- We'll produce a ballpark monthly delta for a 6-week pilot reserved pool vs a comparable on-demand spend by EOD Friday (will include assumptions).
- Nov 14 10am PT works for the deep-dive — Vivek will lead and validate throughput assumptions and isolation tradeoffs.
- For the pilot SOW we typically ask for: non-prod access (read-only metrics + ingress for smoke tests), a procurement PO or contract signature window, and a named technical lead.

Next steps I will do today:
- Draft a 1-page pilot SOW and a short cost delta spreadsheet and drop into the Drive link (shared).
- Vivek — can you confirm whether 3 x A10035GB is a sensible starting point for sustained 100 TPS with ability to handle ~500 TPS bursts when combined with short-lived warm nodes? If not, any alternate suggestions?

Thanks — I'll share the SOW + cost delta shortly.

Best,
Marissa
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 13 Nov 2025 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: NeuralWave pilot — engineering asks (short)

Vivek / Sergio — quick internal ask to prep for the Nov 14 deep-dive with NeuralWave (10am PT). Please reply inline where helpful.

1) Throughput sizing: based on the attached traffic sample (anika attached a CSV) and the model family (Llama-variant, quantized 16-bit), can you validate whether 3 x A10035GB is sufficient to meet steady 100 TPS and provide headroom for 500 TPS burst using warm short-lived nodes? If you need, I can drop a sanitized sample into the infra test cluster.

2) Isolation & networking: what are the minimal networking steps to get NeuralWave a VPC peering/private endpoint during the pilot (we need to outline a checklist for procurement).

3) Pilot SOW bullets: I'll draft the SOW; please add any ops constraints (maintenance windows, rollback policy, monitoring hooks we require).

Goal: have a tech-deck + SOW + cost-delta by EOD so procurement has a clear ask.

Thanks — Marissa
